because: Fingerprints of identifiers that must not appear in this tree, read by tools/quality/check-identifier-fingerprints.ts (fingerprint, normalisation and threat model in its header: masking at read time, not confidentiality). The only entry delivered is a sentinel: its identifier is synthetic, composed at test time by check-identifier-fingerprints.test.ts, and keeps the list non-empty so the gate runs. Real entries are derived by the owner of each list with --derive, from a plain list kept outside the repository, and added here.
